examples: 'tO ha SAntahfdayO pravavrajatuH' (CAM॰u॰8.8.3). pratasTAte ityAha.
'gfhRIyurapi mAtaNgAn mattAn pravrajato vane' (rA॰14.17.28). pravrajataH svacCandagatIn iti katakaH.
'ajAtaSmaSravo mandAH kule jAtAH pravavrajuH' (BA॰SAM॰11.2). parivrajyAM parijagfhaturityarTaH. punargfhaM prati na gantavyamiti prakarzeRa gatA iti tilakaH.
'ata eva brahmacaryavAn pravrajati' (Apa॰Da॰2.21.19). pravrajati prakarzeRa vrajati na pratyAvartata ityarTaH.
'dvipravrAjinI' (ASva0 gf0 1.5.6). dvo pravrajatIti. puMScalIti yAvat.
'rAtsyAma ityapavrajatyaDvaryuH' (ASva॰SrO॰8.13.10). apavrajati=apagacCati. rAtsyAma iti sADayAma ityarTe prayogaH.
'yatrEva saMvrajannanvAhAryapacanamanusmaret' (Sa0 brA0 2.3.2.4). saMvrajan=vicaran=paryawan.
'prapadyamAne rAjanyagreRAno'nusaMvrajet' (ASva SrO0 4.4.5).
'imA: somyAnusaMvrajeti' (CAM0 u0 4.4.5). samyaganuyAhItyAha.
'putrAnsaMnizpAdya brUyurvipravrajatA'smat' (Apa0 Da0 1.10.29.9). vipravrajata nAnA Bavata, viviDaM prakarzeRa snehamutsfjya gacCatetyAha.
'sa tvamAyuDamAdAya kzipramAvraja' (rA0 2.31.31). Avraja=AyAhi, ehi.
'vESvadeve tu nivftte yadyanyo'tiTirAvrajet' (manu0 3.108). ukto'rTaH.
'janako ha vEdeha AsAYcakre. aTa ha yAjYavalkya AvavrAja' (Sa0 brA0 14.6.10.1). AvavrAja=AjagAma.
'tvAmAvrajedyadi rahaH sA putra varavarRinI' (BA0 Adi0 97.21). Avrajet upeyAt.
'sa punarhfdayaM kasya krUrasyApi na nirdahet. kasya hyakaruRasyApi netrAByAmaSrunAvrajet' (BA0 sO0 4.28).. Avrajet pravahet syandeta.
'apareRa vedimativrajya' (ASva0 SrO0 2.3.11). ativrajya laNGayitvA.
'aDyAyamudavrajat' (paYca0 brA0 12.11.10). aDyayanAya niragAdityarTaH.
'yeneto gacCeyuranyena pratyAvrajeyuH' (lAwyA0 SrO0 4.4.17). pratyAvrajeyuH pratyAvarteran.
'madrakezu carakAH paryavrajAma' (Sa0 brA0 14.6.2.1). paryavrajAma paryAwAma.
'asyAH pawavAsaganDenonmattA Bramanto maDukaragaRAScUtaSiKarARyapi tyaktvA parivrajanti KalvenAm' (uBayA0 pf0 6). parivrajanti paripatanti.
'putrasyESvarye pitA vaset pari vA vrajet' (kOzI0 u0 2.15). parivrajet saMnyasyet, aniketano BikzuH syAt.
gfhI BUtvA vanI Bavet, vanI BUtvA parivrajet' (nA0 pari0 u0 3.77 pAWaBedaH).
'devatA vA etaM parivrajanti' (paYca0 brA0 18.1.11). parivrajanti parivarjayanti. nAsya havirAdadata ityarTaH.
'SivamahaM SaraRaM parivrajAmi' (skanda pu0 ke0 91.28). vrajAmItyevArTaH. parirasTAne.
'vAsAMsi matacelAni… parivrajyA ca nityaSaH' (manu0 10.52). parivrajyA BramaRaSIlatvam. parivrajyA saMnyAsaH caturTASramapraveSopi Bavati. parivrAjakaSca saMnyAsI.
'tamindra upavrajyovAca' (tE0 brA0 3.10.11.3) upavrajya upetya.
'na tApasEH…. AkIrRaM BikzukErvAnyErAgAramupasaMvrajet' (manu0 6.51). upasaMvrajet praviSet.

examples.text: rAjan svatejasA tasya saSarIro divaM vraja
